source: pm list permissions on Android 17 (API 37); api-versions.xml from android-37.0

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCEPT_HANDOVER
permissions.description: Allows the app to continue a call which was started in another app.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION
permissions.label: access location in the background
permissions.description: This app can access location at any time, even while the app is not in use.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.label: access approximate location only in the foreground
permissions.description: This app can get your approximate location from location services while the app is in use. Location services for your device must be turned on for the app to get location.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.label: access precise location only in the foreground
permissions.description: This app can get your precise location from location services while the app is in use. Location services for your device must be turned on for the app to get location. This may increase battery usage.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_HIDDEN_PROFILES
permissions.label: Access hidden profiles
permissions.description: Allows the app to access hidden profiles.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK
permissions.label: access local network devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to access local network devices

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS
permissions.label: access extra location provider commands
permissions.description: Allows the app to access extra location provider commands. This may allow the app to interfere with the operation of the GPS or other location sources.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION
permissions.label: read locations from your media collection
permissions.description: Allows the app to read locations from your media collection.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.label: view network connections
permissions.description: Allows the app to view information about network connections such as which networks exist and are connected.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY
permissions.label: access Do Not Disturb
permissions.description: Allows the app to read and write Do Not Disturb configuration.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
permissions.label: view Wi-Fi connections
permissions.description: Allows the app to view information about Wi-Fi networking, such as whether Wi-Fi is enabled and name of connected Wi-Fi devices.

permissions.name: android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
permissions.label: recognize physical activity
permissions.description: This app can recognize your physical activity.

permissions.name: android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS
permissions.label: answer phone calls
permissions.description: Allows the app to answer an incoming phone call.

permissions.name: android.permission.BIND_CARRIER_SERVICES
permissions.label: bind to carrier services
permissions.description: Allows the holder to bind to carrier services. Should never be needed for normal apps.

permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH
permissions.label: pair with Bluetooth devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to view the configuration of the Bluetooth on the phone, and to make and accept connections with paired devices.

permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN
permissions.label: access Bluetooth settings
permissions.description: Allows the app to configure the local Bluetooth phone, and to discover and pair with remote devices.

permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE
permissions.label: advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices

permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
permissions.label: connect to paired Bluetooth devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to connect to paired Bluetooth devices

permissions.name: android.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN
permissions.label: discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to discover and pair nearby Bluetooth devices

permissions.name: android.permission.BODY_SENSORS
permissions.label: Access body sensor data, like heart rate, while in use
permissions.description: Allows the app to access body sensor data, such as heart rate, temperature, and blood oxygen percentage, while the app is in use.

permissions.name: android.permission.BODY_SENSORS_BACKGROUND
permissions.label: Access body sensor data, like heart rate, while in the background
permissions.description: Allows the app to access body sensor data, such as heart rate, temperature, and blood oxygen percentage, while the app is in the background.

permissions.name: android.permission.BROADCAST_STICKY
permissions.label: send sticky broadcast
permissions.description: Allows the app to send sticky broadcasts, which remain after the broadcast ends. Excessive use may make the phone slow or unstable by causing it to use too much memory.

permissions.name: android.permission.CALL_COMPANION_APP
permissions.label: see and control calls through the system.
permissions.description: Allows the app to see and control ongoing calls on the device. This includes information such as call numbers for calls and the state of the calls.

permissions.name: android.permission.CALL_PHONE
permissions.label: directly call phone numbers
permissions.description: Allows the app to call phone numbers without your intervention. This may result in unexpected charges or calls. Note that this doesn't allow the app to call emergency numbers. Malicious apps may cost you money by making calls without your confirmation, or dial carrier codes which cause incoming calls to be automatically forwarded to another number.

permissions.name: android.permission.CAMERA
permissions.label: take pictures and videos
permissions.description: This app can take pictures and record videos using the camera while the app is in use.

permissions.name: android.permission.CAPTURE_KEYBOARD
permissions.label: capture keys
permissions.description: Allows the app to capture keys before system can process system shortcuts and actions.

permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_NETWORK_STATE
permissions.label: change network connectivity
permissions.description: Allows the app to change the state of network connectivity.

permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE
permissions.label: allow Wi-Fi Multicast reception
permissions.description: Allows the app to receive packets sent to all devices on a Wi-Fi network using multicast addresses, not just your phone. It uses more power than the non-multicast mode.

permissions.name: android.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
permissions.label: connect and disconnect from Wi-Fi
permissions.description: Allows the app to connect to and disconnect from Wi-Fi access points and to make changes to device configuration for Wi-Fi networks.

permissions.name: android.permission.DELIVER_COMPANION_MESSAGES
permissions.label: Deliver companion messages
permissions.description: Allows a companion app to deliver companion messages to other devices.

permissions.name: android.permission.DETECT_SCREEN_CAPTURE
permissions.label: detect screen captures of app windows
permissions.description: This app will get notified when a screenshot is taken while the app is in use.

permissions.name: android.permission.DISABLE_KEYGUARD
permissions.label: disable your screen lock
permissions.description: Allows the app to disable the keylock and any associated password security. For example, the phone disables the keylock when receiving an incoming phone call, then re-enables the keylock when the call is finished.

permissions.name: android.permission.EXPAND_STATUS_BAR
permissions.label: expand/collapse status bar
permissions.description: Allows the app to expand or collapse the status bar.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
permissions.label: run foreground service
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services.

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "camera"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "camera"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "connectedDevice"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "connectedDevice"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "dataSync"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "dataSync"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_HEALTH
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "health"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "health"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "location"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "location"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaPlayback"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaPlayback"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROCESSING
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaProcessing"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaProcessing"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "mediaProjection"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "mediaProjection"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "microphone"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "microphone"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_PHONE_CALL
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "phoneCall"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "phoneCall"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_REMOTE_MESSAGING
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "remoteMessaging"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "remoteMessaging"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "specialUse"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "specialUse"

permissions.name: android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SYSTEM_EXEMPTED
permissions.label: run foreground service with the type "systemExempted"
permissions.description: Allows the app to make use of foreground services with the type "systemExempted"

permissions.name: android.permission.GET_ACCOUNTS
permissions.label: find accounts on the device
permissions.description: Allows the app to get the list of accounts known by the phone. This may include any accounts created by applications you have installed.

permissions.name: android.permission.GET_PACKAGE_SIZE
permissions.label: measure app storage space
permissions.description: Allows the app to retrieve its code, data, and cache sizes

permissions.name: android.permission.GET_TASKS
permissions.label: retrieve running apps
permissions.description: Allows the app to retrieve information about currently and recently running tasks. This may allow the app to discover information about which applications are used on the device.

permissions.name: android.permission.HIDE_OVERLAY_WINDOWS
permissions.label: hide other apps overlays
permissions.description: This app can request that the system hides overlays originating from apps from being shown on top of it.

permissions.name: android.permission.HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS
permissions.label: access sensor data at a high sampling rate
permissions.description: Allows the app to sample sensor data at a rate greater than 200 Hz

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.label: have full network access
permissions.description: Allows the app to create network sockets and use custom network protocols. The browser and other applications provide means to send data to the internet, so this permission is not required to send data to the internet.

permissions.name: android.permission.KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES
permissions.label: close other apps
permissions.description: Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_ONGOING_CALLS
permissions.label: Manage ongoing calls
permissions.description: Allows an app to see details about ongoing calls on your device and to control these calls.

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_OWN_CALLS
permissions.label: route calls through the system
permissions.description: Allows the app to route its calls through the system in order to improve the calling experience.

permissions.name: android.permission.MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS
permissions.label: change your audio settings
permissions.description: Allows the app to modify global audio settings such as volume and which speaker is used for output.

permissions.name: android.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES
permissions.label: interact with nearby Wi‑Fi devices
permissions.description: Allows the app to advertise, connect, and determine the relative position of nearby Wi‑Fi devices

permissions.name: android.permission.NFC
permissions.label: control Near Field Communication
permissions.description: Allows the app to communicate with Near Field Communication (NFC) tags, cards, and readers.

permissions.name: android.permission.NFC_PREFERRED_PAYMENT_INFO
permissions.label: Preferred NFC Payment Service Information
permissions.description: Allows the app to get preferred nfc payment service information like registered aids and route destination.

permissions.name: android.permission.NFC_TRANSACTION_EVENT
permissions.label: Secure Element transaction event
permissions.description: Allows the app to receive information about transactions happening on a Secure Element.

permissions.name: android.permission.PERSISTENT_ACTIVITY
permissions.label: make app always run
permissions.description: Allows the app to make parts of itself persistent in memory. This can limit memory available to other apps slowing down the phone.

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.label: show notifications
permissions.description: Allows the app to show notifications

permissions.name: android.permission.POST_PROMOTED_NOTIFICATIONS
permissions.label: Show live updates
permissions.description: Allows the app to display ongoing, time-sensitive notifications on the status bar and lock screen

permissions.name: android.permission.PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS
permissions.label: reroute outgoing calls
permissions.description: Allows the app to see the number being dialed during an outgoing call with the option to redirect the call to a different number or abort the call altogether.

permissions.name: android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES
permissions.label: query all packages
permissions.description: Allows an app to see all installed packages.

permissions.name: android.permission.RANGING
permissions.label: determine relative position between nearby devices
permissions.description: Allow the app to determine relative position between nearby devices

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_BASIC_PHONE_STATE
permissions.label: read basic telephony status and identity
permissions.description: Allows the app to access the basic telephony features of the device.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CALENDAR
permissions.label: Read calendar events and details
permissions.description: This app can read all calendar events stored on your phone and share or save your calendar data.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CALL_LOG
permissions.label: read call log
permissions.description: This app can read your call history.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_CONTACTS
permissions.label: read your contacts
permissions.description: Allows the app to read data about your contacts stored on your phone. Apps will also have access to the accounts on your phone that have created contacts. This may include accounts created by apps you have installed. This permission allows apps to save your contact data, and malicious apps may share contact data without your knowledge.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.label: read the contents of your shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to read the contents of your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO
permissions.label: read audio files from shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to read audio files from your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES
permissions.label: read image files from shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to read image files from your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VIDEO
permissions.label: read video files from shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to read video files from your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED
permissions.label: read user selected image and video files from shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to read image and video files that you select from your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS
permissions.label: read phone numbers
permissions.description: Allows the app to access the phone numbers of the device.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
permissions.label: read phone status and identity
permissions.description: Allows the app to access the phone features of the device. This permission allows the app to determine the phone number and device IDs, whether a call is active, and the remote number connected by a call.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_SMS
permissions.label: read your text messages (SMS or MMS)
permissions.description: This app can read all SMS (text) messages stored on your phone.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_SYNC_SETTINGS
permissions.label: read sync settings
permissions.description: Allows the app to read the sync settings for an account. For example, this can determine whether the People app is synced with an account.

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_SYNC_STATS
permissions.label: read sync statistics
permissions.description: Allows an app to read the sync stats for an account, including the history of sync events and how much data is synced.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
permissions.label: run at startup
permissions.description: Allows the app to have itself started as soon as the system has finished booting. This can make it take longer to start the phone and allow the app to slow down the overall phone by always running.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_MMS
permissions.label: receive text messages (MMS)
permissions.description: Allows the app to receive and process MMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_SMS
permissions.label: receive text messages (SMS)
permissions.description: Allows the app to receive and process SMS messages. This means the app could monitor or delete messages sent to your device without showing them to you.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECEIVE_WAP_PUSH
permissions.label: receive text messages (WAP)
permissions.description: Allows the app to receive and process WAP messages. This permission includes the ability to monitor or delete messages sent to you without showing them to you.

permissions.name: android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO
permissions.label: record audio
permissions.description: This app can record audio using the microphone while the app is in use.

permissions.name: android.permission.REORDER_TASKS
permissions.label: reorder running apps
permissions.description: Allows the app to move tasks to the foreground and background. The app may do this without your input.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_PROFILE_WATCH
permissions.label: Companion Watch profile permission to manage watches
permissions.description: Allows a companion app to manage watches.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_RUN_IN_BACKGROUND
permissions.label: run in the background
permissions.description: This app can run in the background. This may drain battery faster.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_START_FOREGROUND_SERVICES_FROM_BACKGROUND
permissions.label: Start foreground services from background
permissions.description: Allows a companion app to start foreground services from background.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_COMPANION_USE_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND
permissions.label: use data in the background
permissions.description: This app can use data in the background. This may increase data usage.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
permissions.label: request delete packages
permissions.description: Allows an application to request deletion of packages.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS
permissions.label: ask to ignore battery optimizations
permissions.description: Allows an app to ask for permission to ignore battery optimizations for that app.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES
permissions.label: request install packages
permissions.description: Allows an application to request installation of packages.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_OBSERVE_COMPANION_DEVICE_PRESENCE
permissions.label: Observe companion device presence
permissions.description: Allows a companion app to observe companion device presence when the devices are nearby or far-away.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY
permissions.label: request screen lock complexity
permissions.description: Allows the app to learn the screen lock complexity level (high, medium, low or none), which indicates the possible range of length and type of the screen lock. The app can also suggest to users that they update the screen lock to a certain level but users can freely ignore and navigate away. Note that the screen lock is not stored in plaintext so the app does not know the exact password.

permissions.name: android.permission.RESTART_PACKAGES
permissions.label: close other apps
permissions.description: Allows the app to end background processes of other apps. This may cause other apps to stop running.

permissions.name: android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
permissions.label: Schedule precisely timed actions
permissions.description: This app can schedule work to happen at a desired time in the future. This also means that the app can run when you’re not actively using the device.

permissions.name: android.permission.SEND_SMS
permissions.label: send and view SMS messages
permissions.description: Allows the app to send SMS messages. This may result in unexpected charges. Malicious apps may cost you money by sending messages without your confirmation.

permissions.name: android.permission.SET_TIME_ZONE
permissions.label: set time zone
permissions.description: Allows the app to change the phone's time zone.

permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER
permissions.label: set wallpaper
permissions.description: Allows the app to set the system wallpaper.

permissions.name: android.permission.SET_WALLPAPER_HINTS
permissions.label: adjust your wallpaper size
permissions.description: Allows the app to set the system wallpaper size hints.

permissions.name: android.permission.START_VIEW_APP_FEATURES
permissions.label: start view app features
permissions.description: Allows the holder to start viewing the features info for an app.

permissions.name: android.permission.START_VIEW_PERMISSION_USAGE
permissions.label: start view permission usage
permissions.description: Allows the holder to start the permission usage for an app. Should never be needed for normal apps.

permissions.name: android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
permissions.label: This app can appear on top of other apps
permissions.description: This app can appear on top of other apps or other parts of the screen. This may interfere with normal app usage and change the way that other apps appear.

permissions.name: android.permission.TRANSMIT_IR
permissions.label: transmit infrared
permissions.description: Allows the app to use the phone's infrared transmitter.

permissions.name: android.permission.TURN_SCREEN_ON
permissions.label: turn on the screen
permissions.description: Allows the app to turn on the screen.

permissions.name: android.permission.UPDATE_PACKAGES_WITHOUT_USER_ACTION
permissions.label: update app without user action
permissions.description: Allows the holder to update the app it previously installed without user action

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC
permissions.label: use biometric hardware
permissions.description: Allows the app to use biometric hardware for authentication

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_EXACT_ALARM
permissions.label: Schedule alarms or event reminders
permissions.description: This app can schedule actions like alarms and reminders to notify you at a desired time in the future.

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_FINGERPRINT
permissions.label: use fingerprint hardware
permissions.description: Allows the app to use fingerprint hardware for authentication

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT
permissions.label: display notifications as full screen activities on a locked device
permissions.description: Allows the app to display notifications as full screen activities on a locked device

permissions.name: android.permission.USE_SIP
permissions.label: make/receive SIP calls
permissions.description: Allows the app to make and receive SIP calls.

permissions.name: android.permission.UWB_RANGING
permissions.label: determine relative position between nearby Ultra-Wideband devices
permissions.description: Allow the app to determine relative position between nearby Ultra-Wideband devices

permissions.name: android.permission.VIBRATE
permissions.label: control vibration
permissions.description: Allows the app to control the vibrator.

permissions.name: android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
permissions.label: prevent phone from sleeping
permissions.description: Allows the app to prevent the phone from going to sleep.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CALENDAR
permissions.label: add or modify calendar events and send email to guests without owners' knowledge
permissions.description: This app can add, remove, or change calendar events on your phone. This app can send messages that may appear to come from calendar owners, or change events without notifying their owners.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CALL_LOG
permissions.label: write call log
permissions.description: Allows the app to modify your phone's call log, including data about incoming and outgoing calls. Malicious apps may use this to erase or modify your call log.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_CONTACTS
permissions.label: modify your contacts
permissions.description: Allows the app to modify the data about your contacts stored on your phone. This permission allows apps to delete contact data.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.label: modify or delete the contents of your shared storage
permissions.description: Allows the app to write the contents of your shared storage.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
permissions.label: modify system settings
permissions.description: Allows the app to modify the system's settings data. Malicious apps may corrupt your system's configuration.

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_SYNC_SETTINGS
permissions.label: toggle sync on and off
permissions.description: Allows an app to modify the sync settings for an account. For example, this can be used to enable sync of the People app with an account.

permissions.name: com.android.alarm.permission.SET_ALARM
permissions.label: set an alarm
permissions.description: Allows the app to set an alarm in an installed alarm clock app. Some alarm clock apps may not implement this feature.

permissions.name: com.android.launcher.permission.INSTALL_SHORTCUT
permissions.label: install shortcuts
permissions.description: Allows an application to add Homescreen shortcuts without user intervention.

permissions.name: com.android.launcher.permission.UNINSTALL_SHORTCUT
permissions.label: uninstall shortcuts
permissions.description: Allows the application to remove Homescreen shortcuts without user intervention.

permissions.name: com.android.voicemail.permission.ADD_VOICEMAIL
permissions.label: add voicemail
permissions.description: Allows the app to add messages to your voicemail inbox.
